# BINDING CONSISTENCY LEDGER — Basque Listening Pod (15 scenes)

## 1. TRANSLITERATION
Not needed — names stay as written. Basque uses the Latin alphabet. Pin these personal names identically:
- Sarah = Sarah
- Neighbour = [generic role, no name]
- James = James
- Anna = Anna
- Manchester = Manchester
- London = London
- France = France
- Davies = Davies
- Jones = Jones

## 2. PRICES
GBP to EUR at realistic Basque bar/café/restaurant prices (current €1 ≈ £0.86):
- £1 → euro bat (€1.15)
- £2 → bi euro eta hogei zentimo (€2.32)
- £8.40 → dozena euro (€9.77)
- £0.50 → berrogeita hamar zentimo (€0.58)
- £12.50 → hamabost euro (€14.50)

## 3. TARGET-LANGUAGE NAME
Euskera (or Euskal Herria regional variant, but "Euskera" is the standard everyday word Basque speakers use for their own language).

## 4. RECURRING LINES

| English | Basque |
|---------|--------|
| Good morning. What can I get you? | Egun on. Zer nahi duzu? |
| Good afternoon. | Arratsalde on. |
| Good evening. What can I get you? | Gabon. Zer nahi duzu? |
| Would you like to sit-in or takeaway? | Masuan nahi duzu edo kanpora? |
| Could I pay by card? | Txartelaz ordaindu nuke? |
| Do you have contactless? | Ukitu gabe baduzue? |
| Thank you very much. | Eskerrik asko. |
| Goodbye. / See you later. | Agur. / Gero arte. |
| I'm learning Basque. | Euskera ikastzen ari naiz. |
| Pleased to meet you. | Pozik nuen zurekin ezagutzea. |
| Yes, of course. | Bai, jakina. |
| Excuse me. | Barkatu. |
| You're welcome. | Ez da axola. |

## 5. REGISTER

| Relationship | Address Form | Verb Pattern |
|--------------|--------------|--------------|
| Customer–staff / service (stranger) | Zuka (neutral non-allocutive) | 2sg. -zu forms; -duzu, -du, -nuke |
| Peer / friend (young, familiar) | Hika (familiar allocutive) | Allocutive -k (male), -n (female) or neutral -zu if address unspecified |
| Hotel/formal service | Zuka (neutral) | Formal polite -duzu, -dituzu |
| Neighbour (morning/evening) | Zuka / light hika mix | Neutral -zu dominates; -n ending for female listener optional if warm |
